name: Adobe Acrobat Sign
label: Acrobat Sign REST API v6
description: Acrobat Sign REST API v6. Official API https://developer.adobe.com/acrobat-sign/docs/overview/developer_guide/apiusage. One node; pick operation. Upload/download/convert/sign payloads use type file (Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.) Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. SOAP is retired. Discover api_access_point via GET /base_uris. Enterprise provisioned; regional shards. Customer is the sender. Transient document upload then POST /agreements. webhook_listen is ingress (BPMN). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: agreement_create, agreement_get, agreement_cancel, agreement_documents, webhook_listen, group_get, workflow_get, webform_get, megasign_get.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Agreement name for agreement_create. Example: NDA.

schema.label: fileInfos
schema.description: Documents for agreement_create. JSON array of {libraryDocumentId} or {transientDocumentId} or {urlFileInfo:{url}}. Example: [{"libraryDocumentId":"CBJCHBCAABAA…"}].

schema.label: participantSetsInfo
schema.description: Signer sets for agreement_create. JSON array of {memberInfos:[{email}], role, order}. role EXACT: SIGNER | APPROVER | ACCEPTOR | CERTIFIED_RECIPIENT | FORM_FILLER | DELEGATE_TO_SIGNER. Example: [{"memberInfos":[{"email":"ada@example.com"}],"role":"SIGNER","order":1}].

schema.label: signatureType
schema.description: agreement_create signatureType. EXACT: ESIGN | WRITTEN. Example: ESIGN.

schema.label: state
schema.description: agreement_create: IN_PROCESS | DRAFT. agreement_cancel: CANCELLED. Example: IN_PROCESS.

schema.label: agreementId
schema.description: URL path parameter `agreementId` for operations: agreement_get, agreement_cancel, agreement_documents. Required by: agreement_get, agreement_cancel, agreement_documents.

schema.label: comment
schema.description: Cancel comment for agreement_cancel.

schema.label: groupId
schema.description: URL path parameter `groupId` for operation: group_get. Required by: group_get.

schema.label: workflowId
schema.description: URL path parameter `workflowId` for operation: workflow_get. Required by: workflow_get.

schema.label: widgetId
schema.description: URL path parameter `widgetId` for operation: webform_get. Required by: webform_get.

schema.label: megaSignId
schema.description: URL path parameter `megaSignId` for operation: megasign_get. Required by: megasign_get.

schema.label: agreement_id
schema.description: Agreement id for agreement_get/cancel/documents.

schema.label: group_id
schema.description: Group id for group_get.

schema.label: workflow_id
schema.description: Workflow id for workflow_get.

schema.label: widget_id
schema.description: Widget (web form) id for webform_get.

schema.label: megasign_id
schema.description: MegaSign id for megasign_get.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack. Set shard to the account apiAccessPoint host fragment. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Shard
configurationParameters.description: Account shard from GET /baseUris apiAccessPoint (na1, eu1, na4, …). Host is api.{shard}.adobesign.com.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Adobe Sign Client ID
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header X-AdobeSign-ClientId. Never logged.
